name: SalesQL
summary: Verified work and direct emails and phone numbers for a person by LinkedIn URL, email or name, organization profiles, and email verification.

api_key.description: A SalesQL API key (Settings > API Access; Professional and Premium plans). Sent as a Bearer token.

notes: Person enrichment spends credits; organization enrichment and the allowance call are free. salesql.account.allowance gives the rate limits.
Bulk person and organization enrichment and bulk verification jobs are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Get credits and rate limits
endpoints.summary: Remaining credits, plan and rate limits for the key.

endpoints.name: Enrich a person
endpoints.summary: Work and direct emails, phones, title and company for a person, by LinkedIn URL, email, or name with organization.

first_name.description: First name, with last_name and organization.

full_name.description: Full name, instead of first and last.

organization_name.description: Organization name; must be exact when sent without organization_domain.

match_if_direct_email.description: Only match a person with a direct (non-work) email.

match_if_direct_phone.description: Only match a person with a direct phone; ignored on the Free plan.

notes: Consumes enrichment credits. Send one complete group: linkedin_url; email; or a name (first_name + last_name, or full_name) with organization_domain or organization_name.
An ambiguous name match answers 404 asking for the linkedin_url rather than guessing. The Free plan gets no phone numbers.

endpoints.name: Enrich an organization
endpoints.summary: Industry, size, headquarters, logo and LinkedIn of an organization.

linkedin_url.description: LinkedIn company URL; wins over the others.

organization_domain.description: Website domain, reduced to its root.

notes: Free. A domain or name several organizations share answers 404; retry with linkedin_url.

endpoints.name: Verify an email
notes: A read over POST. 1 verification credit (a balance separate from enrichment credits), also when served from the 120-day cache. Needs a key with the verify:verify scope.
unknown is not an error: the domain's mail servers could not be checked.
